This 2019 Ford F-150 King Ranch in gray represents a well-appointed truck built for both work and refined daily driving.

- Twin Panel Moonroof
- Max Trailer Tow Package with Pro Trailer Backup Assist

The Max Trailer Tow Package equips this truck with professional-grade towing features, including an integrated trailer brake controller and electronic locking differentials. The extended range fuel tank provides the extended range needed for longer trips and heavy-use scenarios.

The FX4 Off-Road Package adds genuine capability with skid plates protecting the fuel tank, transfer case, and front differential. Off-road tuned front shock absorbers and hill descent control allow confident navigation over challenging terrain, while the tray-style floor liner protects the cabin during rugged use.

Inside, the King Ranch cabin features genuine wood dashboard and door panel inserts that establish a premium environment. Leather bucket seats with heating and ventilation functions provide comfort across seasons, and the heated steering wheel adds practicality during cold weather. Navigation, AppLink/Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto integration ensure modern connectivity.

This F-150 King Ranch combines work capability with refined comfort, making it suitable for those who demand both performance and daily-drive refinement.

The 2020 Honda Pilot EX-L is the perfect SUV for growing families and active lifestyles, offering three rows of seating, premium comfort features, and advanced safety technology. With its refined styling, spacious interior, and impressive versatility, this Pilot is ready for everything from daily commutes to weekend road trips.

As a Honda Certified Pre-Owned vehicle, it has undergone a comprehensive inspection and reconditioning process, giving you added confidence and peace of mind with your purchase.

Performance & Capability

Powered by a proven V6 engine and paired with a smooth-shifting automatic transmission, the Pilot delivers strong performance while maintaining the comfort and efficiency you expect from a Honda SUV.

- 3.5L V6 engine
- Automatic transmission
- Available AWD capability
- Smooth, confident ride
- Excellent balance of power and efficiency

Interior Comfort & Versatility

Step inside and discover a spacious cabin designed to keep everyone comfortable.

- Leather-trimmed seating surfaces
- Heated front bucket seats
- Power driver's seat with memory settings
- Dual-zone automatic climate control
- Rear air conditioning
- Reclining third-row seating
- Spacious cabin with seating for up to eight passengers
- Power moonroof

Technology & Connectivity

Stay connected and entertained with intuitive technology features throughout the cabin.

- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- SiriusXM capability
- 215-Watt audio system with 7 speakers
- Steering wheel-mounted audio controls
- Remote keyless entry
- Auto-dimming rearview mirror

Safety & Driver Confidence

Honda Sensing? technology helps provide peace of mind for every journey.

- Blind Spot Information System (BSI)
- Collision Mitigation Braking System (CMBS)
- Forward Collision Warning (FCW)
- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS)
- Auto High-Beam Headlights
- Rearview backup camera
- Advanced airbag system

Convenience Features

Designed to make family life easier and more enjoyable.

- Power liftgate for easy cargo access
- Heated power mirrors
- Turn signal indicator mirrors
- Flexible seating and cargo configurations
- Ample storage space throughout the cabin

Exterior Highlights

The Pilot EX-L combines rugged SUV capability with sophisticated styling.

- 18" machine-finished alloy wheels
- Power moonroof
- Front fog lights
- Rear spoiler
- Sleek, modern Honda design

Key Features

- EX-L trim
- Honda Certified Pre-Owned
- Leather interior
- Heated front seats
- Power moonroof
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- Blind Spot Monitoring
- Honda Sensing? safety suite
- Power liftgate
- Three-row seating

The 2020 Honda Pilot EX-L is an outstanding choice for drivers seeking a comfortable, capable, and family-friendly SUV. With its premium features, advanced safety systems, and Honda Certified confidence, this Pilot delivers exceptional value and versatility for every adventure.

Schedule your test drive today at Columbia Honda and experience why the Honda Pilot continues to be one of the most trusted SUVs on the road.

This 2014 Toyota Tacoma Base V6 represents a capable truck ready for work and adventure. With its silver exterior and 4WD capability, this Tacoma is built to handle demanding terrain and challenging weather conditions.

- 17 alloy wheels with all-weather floor mats
- Leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob with audio controls
- Remote Keyless Entry System and cruise control

This truck delivers practical performance with an EPA-estimated 16 city and 21 highway MPG. The sport-tuned Bilstein shocks paired with TRD coil springs provide responsive handling whether navigating tight trails or highway driving.

The interior combines functionality with comfort. The Entune Premium Audio system offers navigation, smartphone integration through Bluetooth, and access to real-time traffic and weather information. Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, anti-whiplash front head restraints, and electronic stability control working together to protect occupants. The backup camera and front fog lamps enhance visibility in various driving conditions.

The Towing Package equips this truck for serious hauling with a heavy-duty battery, supplemental oil cooler, and 7-pin connector with converter. These components work together to ensure reliable towing performance when you need it most.

This 2014 Tacoma has earned its reputation for durability and dependability. With the right combination of capability, technology, and safety features, this truck stands ready for your next chapter. We invite you to visit our showroom and experience what this truck can deliver for your lifestyle.

===== About This 2014 Mercedes-Benz E 63 AMG 4MATIC =====

At 123,900 miles, this E 63 AMG sits in a mileage range that tells a story of a car that's been driven and enjoyed not babied in a garage, but not neglected either. description:
The 2017 Toyota Tacoma Limited V6 is a midsize pickup truck designed to blend proven reliability with upscale comfort and real-world capability.

This truck is a strong match for buyers seeking a high-value, long-lasting pickup that can handle both professional and personal needs. Its clean vehicle history and upscale features make it especially appealing for those looking to upgrade from an older truck or searching for a dependable option for hauling, commuting, or weekend projects. In areas like Bastrop, TX, where light towing and versatile cargo are common, the Tacoma s practical bed management, covered by a hard tri-fold tonneau, and comfortable cabin suit a range of lifestyles. Its reputation for durability and resale strength further enhances its appeal to those prioritizing long-term value.

Powering the Tacoma Limited is a V6 engine mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission, offering responsive acceleration and smooth shifting that adapts well to both city commutes and highway cruising. The rear-wheel drive configuration ensures a direct, confident driving feel on paved roads, while features like speed-sensing steering and front wheel independent suspension contribute to composed handling. This setup is ideal for drivers who need reliable performance for daily errands, light loads, or occasional towing with the included Tow Package and Class IV Hitch Receiver, without sacrificing comfort or efficiency.

Safety in the Tacoma Limited is anchored by a comprehensive suite of active and passive features. Anti-lock brakes (ABS), electronic stability control, and traction control work together to help maintain stability in slippery or sudden-stop scenarios. Airbags are positioned throughout the cabin, including dual front, dual side, knee, and overhead locations, providing occupant protection from multiple angles. The exterior parking camera rear aids in safe maneuvering while backing up or parking, and trailer sway control enhances security when towing, particularly in challenging conditions or windy weather.

Inside and out, this truck is equipped for both comfort and utility. The Limited trim includes Hickory leather front bucket seats, automatic climate control, and an auto-dimming rear-view mirror for pleasant long drives. Audio and connectivity are handled by an AM/FM radio with SiriusXM, a CD player, and steering wheel mounted controls, keeping entertainment and navigation within easy reach. The hard tri-fold tonneau cover secures bed cargo, while remote keyless entry, power windows, and power door mirrors streamline entry and daily operation. Fog lights and front reading lights round out the practical, user-friendly features.

Among midsize pickups, the Tacoma Limited stands out for its blend of proven reliability and high resale value, as recognized by industry awards. Compared to the Chevrolet Colorado and Nissan Frontier, it offers a more refined interior and a reputation for long-term durability.

What are the key features of this vehicle? The Tacoma Limited includes Hickory leather seats, hard tri-fold tonneau cover, Tow Package, Class IV Hitch Receiver, and a suite of active safety systems. How does it perform in daily driving? The V6 engine and 6-speed automatic transmission provide smooth, responsive power for commuting or hauling.

To learn more or schedule a test drive, contact Covert Chevrolet Bastrop at or visit 702 State Hwy 71, Bastrop, TX 78602. Their team can provide detailed information on this 2017 Tacoma Limited V6 and answer any questions to help you make an informed decision.

- EcoDiesel 3.0L V6 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD with electric shift-on-demand transfer case

The Big Horn trim delivers genuine comfort and convenience without unnecessary complexity. You'll appreciate the leather-wrapped steering wheel, dual-zone climate control, and the intuitive Uconnect system that keeps you connected. The power-folding mirrors and remote start system add practical touches that make daily use more convenient. Security features include a security alarm and remote keyless entry, giving you peace of mind whether you're in the driveway or away from the truck.

Inside, the 40/20/40 split bench seat with storage in the front center armrest provides flexibility for passengers or cargo. Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel mean comfort during cold months, while the overhead console with universal garage door opener adds utility. The electroluminescent instrument cluster provides clear visibility in any lighting condition, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you manage the audio system without taking your hands off the wheel.

This truck is designed for those who value both capability and practicality. The Class IV receiver hitch, trailer brake control, and anti-spin differential rear axle support towing and hauling when you need them. LED bed lighting makes nighttime loading easier, and the rear step bumper provides convenient stepping access to the bed.

With 104,885 miles on the odometer, this Big Horn has been well-maintained and continues to offer strong performance and reliability. The combination of the EcoDiesel engine's efficiency, the truck's practical Big Horn features, and its strong construction makes this a solid choice for buyers seeking a capable full-size pickup that doesn't demand constant trips to the fuel pump.

We invite you to see this Ram 1500 in person and experience its commanding presence and refined capability firsthand.
